note: Frozen before any STEP 5-3 pilot or main run. The evaluation must use this preregistration; a change requires a new version with a recorded reason.

revision.reason: In the 5-2b baseline, 3.6% of inputs have exactly equal bf16 'Yes' and 'No' logits (all answered No through the lower token id) and 11% are within one bf16 step (|bf16 margin| <= 0.125). The fast path computes the same model in a different order, so such ties can break differently without any error, and the v1 rule (answer agreement >= 99% over all inputs) could stop a correct run. Recorded before any STEP 5-3 pilot or main output existed.
changes: Answer-agreement criterion: >= 99% among compared pairs whose comparison-standard bf16 margin is more than one bf16 step from a tie (|margin| > 0.125); the all-pair answer agreement is reported as a reference value.
The margin criterion is unchanged and applies to all pairs, near-ties included (|fp32 variant margin difference| <= 0.25 in >= 99%).

Inputs whose no-intervention answer on the new computation path differs from the baseline answer are excluded from all analyses (both halves) and counted; a sensitivity analysis including them replaces the v1 sensitivity analysis restricted to unchanged answers.
revision.unchanged: hypotheses, units and items, split, interventions, outcomes, minimum effects, selection rules, decision rules, statistics

preregistration.version_note: v3: user decisions 1-7 (2026-11-13) incorporated; robust label requires both class CIs. Frozen v2: answer-agreement scope and exclusion of changed inputs (see revision)
preregistration.scope: Tests whether the answer depends on attention from the text tokens after the images (question and chat-template tokens, including the last input token) to the N image's tokens, by blocking or boosting that attention within one 4-layer band and comparing with the same intervention on one P image of the same input. The N location is taken from the ground truth (oracle); this is a mechanism test, not a deployable correction. Images and baseline outputs are reused from STEP 5-2 / 5-2b (selection / confirmation split), not an independent test on new images.

data.split: selection / confirmation halves by N image ID, seed 53 (configs/data/step5_causal_split.yaml)
data.grid: STEP 5-2b one-N inputs, 3-5 images, every N position (11,520 inputs)
data.block_population: inputs answered No in the 5-2b main run (Correct-No): 6,499
data.boost_population: inputs answered Yes in the 5-2b main run (False-Yes): 5,021
data.all_positive: STEP 5-2 All-P inputs with 3-5 images answered Yes in the 5-2 main run: 3,994 (side effects only)
data.baseline_answers: fixed from the baseline runs before any 5-3 output; inclusion never uses 5-3 outputs
data.exclusion: Frozen v2. An input whose no-intervention row on the new computation path answers differently from the baseline answer is excluded from all analyses in both halves (band selection, B-H1 / B-H2, secondary and descriptive results, All-P side effects) and counted by half and population.

intervention.query_primary: every input position after the last image's vision-end marker up to and including the last input token (question text and chat-template tokens; 26-28 tokens per input in 5-2b), all 16 attention heads; generated tokens are not modified
intervention.query_secondary: the last input token only (the v1 primary site); reported as a secondary analysis (one-N only)
intervention.target_tokens: the image's image-pad token span (manifest image_spans); vision start / end marker tokens are not included
intervention.block: the additive attention mask entries from the query positions to the target tokens are set to the minimum of the mask dtype (bf16) in every layer of the band: target weight 0, the rest renormalized
intervention.boost: log(4) added to those attention logits before the softmax in every layer of the band, stored in the mask dtype (bf16: 1.3828125, a multiplicative factor of 3.986 on the target's unnormalized weight)

targets.P_control: the P image of the same input whose image token count is closest to the N image's; ties -> the one closest in position to N; then the earlier one
targets.all_positive: the image in the N slot (5-2 placement) and a control P image chosen by the same rule; primary query only

intervention.generation: greedy, max_new_tokens 8, the model's generation config (repetition penalty 1.05) as in the baseline extraction; continues from the intervened state
intervention.computation: Fast path: the prefix up to and including the last image's vision-end marker is computed once per input with a KV cache; the post-image tokens are recomputed for all conditions of an input in one batch (explicit additive 4D mask in every layer), with the no-intervention row in the same batch.

outcomes.delta: Delta m(target) = intervened margin minus the no-intervention margin of the same batch
outcomes.contrast: C = Delta m(N) - Delta m(P_control), per input

band_selection.block: the band with the largest mean C over the block population
band_selection.boost: the band with the smallest (most negative) mean C over the boost population
band_selection.ties: means within 1e-9 are ties -> the earliest band
band_selection.record: written to selection.json (with a SHA-256 of its content) by the evaluation code before any confirmation-half value is computed
band_selection.secondary_query: bands for the last-token-only condition are chosen by the same rule and reported descriptively

B-H1.name: necessity of attention to N
B-H1.statement: Blocking attention from the post-image text tokens to N raises the Yes - No margin of Correct-No inputs, and raises it more than blocking attention to a P image.

estimates.contrast: mean C under blocking at the selected block band, over confirmation-half block inputs
estimates.n_arm: mean Delta m(N) under the same blocking, same inputs

B-H1.weighting: each input equal weight; image counts and positions pooled

B-H2.name: correction by boosting attention to N
B-H2.statement: Boosting attention from the post-image text tokens to N lowers the Yes - No margin of False-Yes inputs, and lowers it more than boosting attention to a P image.

estimates.contrast: mean C under boosting at the selected boost band, over confirmation-half boost inputs
estimates.n_arm: mean Delta m(N) under the same boosting, same inputs

B-H2.weighting: each input equal weight; image counts and positions pooled

hypotheses.note: B-H1 and B-H2 are decided separately; neither changes any STEP 5-2 / 5-2b decision.

minimum_effect.rationale: Larger than the 5-2b H1b margin effect (middle minus last, +0.36) and smaller than the 5-2 N-last P4 - P1 margin effect (+0.87); four bf16 margin steps (0.125). Preliminary projected 97.5% CI half-width per half: 0.05-0.18 using the baseline margin SD (1.21) as a proxy for the SD of C and Delta m(N) (0.08-0.29 if the SD is 2.0).

decision.level: 97.5% intervals (Bonferroni for two primary hypotheses), N-image cluster bootstrap
decision.joint_condition_note: Support requires both the contrast condition and the N-arm condition; because both must hold (intersection-union), no further multiplicity adjustment is applied.

B-H1.supported: (1) mean C >= 0.5 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI lower bound of C > 0; AND (2) mean Delta m(N) > 0 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI lower bound of Delta m(N) > 0
B-H1.robust_label: 'robust support' only if the class cluster 97.5% CI lower bounds of both C and Delta m(N) are also > 0; otherwise 'support (cross-class generalization uncertain)' (confirmed by the user, 2026-11-13)
B-H1.no_meaningful_difference: N-image cluster 97.5% CI upper bound of C < 0.5
B-H1.otherwise: inconclusive; the unmet condition is stated (contrast, N arm, or both)

B-H2.supported: (1) mean C <= -0.5 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI upper bound of C < 0; AND (2) mean Delta m(N) < 0 AND N-image cluster 97.5% CI upper bound of Delta m(N) < 0
B-H2.robust_label: 'robust support' only if the class cluster 97.5% CI upper bounds of both C and Delta m(N) are also < 0; otherwise 'support (cross-class generalization uncertain)' (confirmed by the user, 2026-11-13)
B-H2.no_meaningful_difference: N-image cluster 97.5% CI lower bound of C > -0.5
B-H2.otherwise: inconclusive; the unmet condition is stated (contrast, N arm, or both)

decision.p_arm_report: Delta m(P_control) for the same inputs and band is always reported with its sign, estimate and 97.5% N-image cluster CI (no decision); it shows whether C comes from the N side or the P side.

statistics.method: percentile cluster bootstrap; 97.5% for B-H1 / B-H2 and the P-arm report, 95% for secondary results (labelled)
statistics.resampling_unit: N image ID within the confirmation half; all inputs of a drawn N image enter together

secondary.last_token_only: C, Delta m(N) and Delta m(P_control) for the last-token-only query condition (at its own selected bands and at the primary bands)
secondary.answer_change: block: share of Correct-No inputs whose answer becomes Yes; boost: share of False-Yes inputs whose answer becomes No (oracle correction rate); N and P targets, at the selected bands
secondary.breakdown: by image count (3, 4, 5) and N position (first / middle / last), at the selected bands
secondary.band_curves: mean C, Delta m(N), Delta m(P) for all nine bands, both halves and both query conditions; confirmation-half bands other than the selected ones are exploratory
secondary.margin_bf16: the same contrasts with the bf16 'Yes' / 'No' margin
secondary.all_positive_side_effect: block and boost (primary query) on the N-slot image and on the control P image of All-P inputs answering Yes without intervention (confirmation half): share whose answer becomes No (95% CI at the selected bands, estimates for every band) and Delta margin; a share above 0.05 at a selected band is flagged as a warning
secondary.sensitivity: contrasts repeated (1) including the inputs excluded because their no-intervention answer changed (frozen v2) and (2) without inputs whose baseline bf16 margin sign disagrees with the baseline answer (ties included)

interpretation: Oracle N location: the result shows dependence on attention to N, not a usable correction method.

Only the direct path from the post-image text tokens to N is changed. Image tokens after N may already carry information from N, and that indirect path is left intact; its size depends on the N position (none for N-last), which is stated when positions are compared.
The P control matches token count, not position; position differences between N and the control remain.
Images and baseline outputs are reused (selection / confirmation split), not an independent test on new images.
preregistration.revision_note: v1 used the last input token as the only query and excluded the question-text-span variant as a separate candidate. v2 (user, 2026-11-13) makes the post-image text tokens (question span + last token) the primary query, which absorbs that variant; the last-token-only condition becomes secondary. A question-span-only condition (without the last token) is not included.
integrity_checks: no-intervention fast path reproduces the 5-2b / 5-2 baseline: parsed answer agreement >= 0.99 among inputs whose baseline bf16 margin is more than one bf16 step from a tie (|margin| > 0.125), and |fp32 variant margin difference| <= 0.25 in >= 99% of all inputs (else stop); all-input answer agreement reported (frozen v2)
fast path vs reference path (model.generate full prefill with the same attention change) on every pilot row: same thresholds, near-ties judged on the reference row (else stop)
zero-size intervention row (pilot) equals the no-intervention row of the same batch within the same thresholds, near-ties judged on the no-intervention row; the exact-equality share is reported
image token spans and the post-image boundary identical to the baseline runs (checked for every input before running)
run.json records GPU type, driver, CUDA and library versions
reported_not_decided: answer agreement over all compared pairs, near-ties included (frozen v2 reference value)
numbers of excluded inputs (changed no-intervention answer) by half and population

rules: any integrity criterion fails (pilot or main)
estimated main-run time from measured pilot times exceeds the limit
